issues.title: Upcoming activities that are not pinned as 'featured' never appear on the public site
issues.file: assets/api.js:496-507 (renderFeatured pool), assets/api.js:1115-1117 (renderPastCarousel only past), assets/api.js:331 (renderActivities never called); assets/admin.js featured hint
issues.description: renderFeatured uses `pool = feat.length ? feat : items`. While any activity has featured=true, upcoming activities without the flag are filtered out. The only other activity list on /activities and the home page is renderPastCarousel, which shows only date < today. MCCMU.renderActivities exists but no page calls it. Live /data today: 19 published activities, exactly one featured (2026-10-11). So any newly published upcoming activity with the featured switch off (the default) is invisible until its date has passed, and then it only shows as 'past'. The admin form hint ('กิจกรรมเด่นจะขึ้นเป็นการ์ดใหญ่ในหน้าแรกและหน้ากิจกรรม') suggests unpinned activities still show somewhere smaller.
reproduction_steps: In admin (mock), add an activity dated in the future, keep 'ปักหมุดเป็นกิจกรรมเด่น' off, and publish.
Open /activities or / on the public site.
The activity is not in the featured block (pool is only featured items) or in 'กิจกรรมที่ผ่านมา' (only past dates).
issues.user_impact: Students can't find upcoming events, which is the main reason to visit /activities. Admins think they published an event, but nobody can see it.
issues.recommended_fix: Show all upcoming published activities in a list or carousel on /activities (renderActivities or an upcoming carousel), or pick upcoming items from all activities and use 'featured' only to promote them. Update the admin hint to say where unpinned activities appear.
issues.evidence: Code path above, plus live data from GET /data?sheet=all: 19 activities, featured=True only on 2026-10-11. HEAD has the same logic, so this already exists in production and is not a regression.

issues.title: /activities featured block says 'upcoming' over a past event, and never leaves 'กำลังโหลด…' when loading fails
issues.file: activities.html:41 (h2 has no data-feat-heading), activities.html:53 (static .feat-upcoming badge), assets/api.js:484-492 (_setFeatHeading)
issues.description: _setFeatHeading only rewrites `[data-feat-heading]`. index.html:73 has that attribute; activities.html:41 does not. On 13 Oct 2569 the activities page shows the 11 ต.ค. 2569 event under 'กิจกรรมเด่นเร็ว ๆ นี้', with the card badge also reading 'กิจกรรมเด่นเร็ว ๆ นี้' (EN: 'Upcoming featured events'). The home page correctly switches to 'กิจกรรมล่าสุดที่ผ่านมา' and 'จัดไปแล้ว'. On a data error (seen with ?preview and no session), _setFeatHeading('none') cannot hide the section, so the card stays on 'กำลังโหลดกิจกรรม…' / 'Loading event…' indefinitely, while the carousel and albums below show proper error messages.
reproduction_steps: Open /activities while no featured activity is upcoming (true today).
Read the heading and badge over the 11 ต.ค. event.
Open /activities?preview in a browser with no admin session and wait more than 9 seconds. The featured card still shows 'Loading event…'.
issues.user_impact: Students may turn up for an event that already happened. On errors the page looks stuck.
issues.recommended_fix: Add data-feat-heading to the h2 at activities.html:41. When showing a past event, also switch the .feat-upcoming badge to 'จัดไปแล้ว' or hide it, and hide or replace the card with an error message on failure.
issues.evidence: get_page_text on /activities: 'กิจกรรมเด่นเร็ว ๆ นี้ … บทเรียนจากบรรพชน … 11 ต.ค. 2569'. On ?preview after 9 s the featuredEvt innerText was 'UPCOMING FEATURED EVENTS Loading event… Please wait — fetching the latest event.' and the console showed '[MCCMU] featured: Error: preview: no admin session'.

issues.title: Admin: unsaved settings edits are dropped without warning when leaving the page, and no admin form protects against reload or tab close
issues.page: /admin (ตั้งค่าเว็บ, all forms)
issues.file: assets/admin.js:442 (go() has no dirty check), assets/admin.js:1609-1614 (settings save bar), no 'beforeunload' anywhere in assets/admin.js
issues.description: On ตั้งค่าเว็บ I changed อีเมลชมรม, and the save bar showed 'แก้ไข 1 ช่อง ยังไม่ได้บันทึก'. Clicking 'ผู้ดูแลระบบ' in the sidebar switched pages with no confirm (a confirm spy recorded 0 calls). Going back to ตั้งค่าเว็บ showed the old value 'club@example.com'. Content forms do confirm on X, Escape and scrim, but there is no beforeunload handler, so a reload, an accidental tab close or a back-swipe throws away a long description with no prompt.
reproduction_steps: Admin, then ตั้งค่าเว็บ: edit any field. The bar 'แก้ไข 1 ช่อง ยังไม่ได้บันทึก' appears.
Click another sidebar item, then come back to ตั้งค่าเว็บ.
The edit is gone and no prompt was shown.
issues.user_impact: Admins lose their changes and may believe they were saved.
issues.recommended_fix: In go(), if the settings page or an open form is dirty, confirm before switching. Add a beforeunload listener while any form or settings page is dirty.
issues.evidence: javascript_tool: window.__c=[] (confirm spy) after the sidebar click, then s_club_email.value === 'club@example.com'. grep -n beforeunload assets/admin.js finds nothing.

issues.title: 'ขึ้นเว็บภายใน ~3 นาที' is optimistic: returning visitors, including the admin checking, first see the old content
issues.file: assets/api.js:108-109 (LS_TTL 3 min, LS_MAX 7 days), assets/api.js:127-150 (stale-while-revalidate in _loadAll), api/data.js:31-32 (max-age=120, s-maxage=180, stale-while-revalidate=60); toasts in assets/admin.js submit() and settings save
issues.description: After saving, admin toasts promise the change is live within ~3 minutes. But any browser that visited in the last 7 days with a localStorage cache older than 3 minutes renders the cached copy right away and only fetches new data in the background, so the change appears on the next page load. That fetch can itself hit the HTTP cache (max-age=120) and an edge copy (s-maxage=180 plus 60 s SWR). An admin who publishes, waits 3 minutes and opens the site in the same browser will usually still see the old version.
reproduction_steps: Visit / so localStorage mccmu_all_v1 is filled.
Wait more than 3 minutes, publish a change in admin, then wait the stated ~3 minutes.
Reload /. The first render uses the cached copy (age < LS_MAX). The new data only appears on a later reload.
issues.user_impact: Admins think publishing failed and edit or republish again. Visitors see outdated event info.
issues.recommended_fix: Make the toast honest (for example 'ภายใน ~5 นาที · ถ้ายังไม่เห็นให้รีเฟรชอีกครั้ง'), or let the admin's browser bypass the cache (?fresh or clearing mccmu_all_v1) after a save. Consider a lower LS_MAX for event data.
issues.evidence: Code at the cited lines. The toast text 'บันทึกแล้ว · ขึ้นเว็บภายใน ~3 นาที' was seen after publishing an activity and saving settings in the mock.

issues.title: Phone Back gesture while browsing an album leaves the page instead of closing the photo viewer
issues.description: I opened album 'Steadfastness 2026' and moved to 'รูปที่ 2 / 154', then went Back in history. The browser left /activities and landed on '/' (navigation type back_forward), and the album viewer and scroll position were gone. On Android and iOS, swiping or pressing Back is the natural way to close a full-screen viewer.
reproduction_steps: On a phone, open /activities and tap an album, then a photo.
Press the Back button or swipe back.
issues.user_impact: Students get kicked off the page and lose their place in long albums (154 photos). It feels broken.
issues.recommended_fix: Push a history entry (for example #album=<id>) when the dialog opens and close it on popstate. Pop the entry when it is closed with X or Escape.
issues.evidence: After navigate('back'): location.href = 'http://localhost:8904/', dialogOpen = false. grep for pushState or popstate in assets/gallery.js finds nothing.

issues.title: Settings accept social links without https://, which then become broken relative links on every page
issues.page: /admin ตั้งค่าเว็บ, then all public pages
issues.file: assets/admin.js:1615-1627 (settings save, no validation), assets/api.js:1048-1056 (setHref uses the raw value)
issues.description: I typed 'facebook.com/MuslimClubCMU' into Facebook and saved. Toast: 'บันทึกแล้ว · ขึ้นเว็บภายใน ~3 นาที', with no warning. applySettings does `a.href = url`, so every Facebook icon would point at /facebook.com/MuslimClubCMU on the club's own domain, which is a 404. The only guard is the hint text 'ลิงก์เพจแบบเต็ม เช่น https://facebook.com/…'.
reproduction_steps: Admin, then ตั้งค่าเว็บ, then Facebook = 'facebook.com/MuslimClubCMU', then บันทึก.
On a public page the footer and contact Facebook links resolve relative to the site.
issues.user_impact: One small typo breaks the social links on every page, and the admin gets no warning.
issues.recommended_fix: Validate URL fields on save (require ^https?://, or prepend https:// automatically) and show an inline error. The same applies to YouTube and the halal map embed URL.
issues.evidence: Mock save toast seen, s_club_facebook.value = 'facebook.com/MuslimClubCMU'. The setHref code at api.js:1048-1052 has no scheme check.

issues.title: Pasting photo links silently drops lines that aren't Drive links

issues.title: Album 'โฟลเดอร์รูป' field still says 'ยังไม่มีรูป · วางลิงก์…' after a valid folder link is pasted
issues.page: /admin อัลบั้มภาพ form

issues.title: The new /gallery page is cut off from the site navigation

issues.title: Admin login after a failed permission check shows a raw error and only offers a full Google sign-in again
issues.description: When the admins lookup fails (network or Supabase hiccup), the login screen shows 'ตรวจสอบสิทธิ์ไม่สำเร็จ: <raw message>' (in the browser this is usually the English 'Failed to fetch') and returns to the 'เข้าสู่ระบบด้วย Google' state, even though the session is still valid (mock_session kept). There is no 'ลองใหม่' button. The admin has to do a full OAuth round trip or guess to reload.
reproduction_steps: Set mock_fail=1 with mock_session=1 and reload the admin mock.
issues.user_impact: A brief network problem looks like a login or permission problem.
issues.recommended_fix: On error, keep the session, show a friendly Thai message with a 'ลองใหม่' button that re-runs boot(), and leave the Google button for real sign-out cases.
issues.evidence: Mock: loginView text 'ตรวจสอบสิทธิ์ไม่สำเร็จ: simulated network failure / เข้าสู่ระบบด้วย Google'. localStorage.mock_session still '1'.

notes.text: gallery.html, assets/gallery.js, assets/gallery.css, assets/videos.js, assets/videos.css and assets/lattice.svg are untracked (git status '??'), but the modified tracked pages load them (activities.html:14,18; knowledge.html:15,20). Production returns 404 for /gallery, /assets/gallery.js and /assets/videos.js today. If deploys come from git, these files must be committed or the album viewer and video section break.

Album 'Steadfastness 2026' is dated 2026-10-26, which is in the future. The photos show '26 SEP 2026' and the activity is 26 ก.ย., so it sorts first with the wrong date. 'Steadfastness' (27 ก.ย.) and 'Steadfastness 2026' look like duplicates to a visitor.

Halal place descriptions contain internal or editor notes and typos visible to students: 'ตำแหน่งปัจจุบันรอยืนยัน' (Fatimah Burger House), 'Google Maps จัดหมวดเป็นร้านอาหารฮาลาล', 'ห้องนำ้' (tone mark order), 'เ ป็น' (stray space), a zero-width space after 'มัสยิดช้างเผือก', and the knowledge title 'มุสลิเข้าร่วม' (missing ม). The per-card mini-maps search by name, so unverified addresses may show the wrong spot.

UX opinion: /halal-map lists 23 restaurants in no particular order, with no distance, area filter or search. The place closest to CMU (Halal Kitchen CMU MED) is 10th. Campus prayer rooms are mixed in with city mosques. A 'ใกล้ มช.' sort or chips (ในมช. / นิมมาน / ช้างคลาน) would help newcomers.

Activities have no time field (admin form fields: title, date, location, description, featured, cover). The public featured card has a time slot that is always hidden, so students can't see when an event starts.
The first video's date (30 ส.ค. 2569) is the YouTube upload date, while the event was 15 ส.ค. (the second video's date comes from its description). The same calendar icon is used for both meanings.

Each video playlist item contains the 'กำลังเปิด' label hidden only with opacity:0, so screen readers announce 'now playing' on every item. activities and halal-map have no <main> element (document.querySelector('main') returned null).

'บันทึกและดูตัวอย่าง' opens the generic list page (/activities.html?preview), not the item just saved. For a future, non-featured activity the preview won't show it at all (see the HIGH issue), which makes the preview look broken to the admin.
